config.notes: Bond program pages (bond.edu.au/program/<slug>) carry a key-facts panel: Duration, Program Type, Study Area, Starting Semester (a select list of month + year, e.g. "September 2026 January 2027 May 2027"), Delivery Mode, Location. Intakes read from Starting Semester. Fees are NOT on the program page: they sit on /program/<slug>/fees, loaded by a JavaScript widget and charged per semester subject-by-subject (no annual figure), so no fee pattern. English is NOT on the program page: it is on /program/<slug>/entry_requirements (e.g. Bachelor of Actuarial Science: IELTS Academic overall 6.5, no sub score below 6.0), so no IELTS pattern. No term_months: the page prints month names directly. International view (5 Oct 13:02): program pages are read through Firecrawl (page_view render, wait 5 s, url_pattern bond.edu.au/program/<slug>) so the key-facts panel renders; the rendered page shows the student-type selector set to "I'm an International Student" (captured as student_type), Starting Semester and Delivery Mode. No URL variant is needed. Fee and IELTS are still not on the program page (separate /fees and /entry_requirements pages).
